title: The closure of the image of V(J) in Spec R is V(phi^{-1}J)
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $J\subseteq S$ an ideal. Then the closure in $\operatorname{Spec}R$ of the image of $V(J)=\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}S:\ J\subseteq\mathfrak q\}$ under $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ is $V(\varphi^{-1}(J))=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}R:\ \varphi^{-1}(J)\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$.
